### bar plot showing cell numbers in the pool based on demuxafy assignment
```{r fig.height=3}
# get singlet cell counts
df_singlets <- subpage_data[!(subpage_data$sample_id %in% c("doublet", "unassigned")), ]
#total_singlets <- sum(subpage_data$number_of_cells[!subpage_data$sample_id %in% c("doublet", "unassigned")])
#subpage_data$frac <- subpage_data$number_of_cells/total_singlets
#subpage_data$sample_id <- factor(subpage_data$sample_id)
total_singlets <- sum(df_singlets$number_of_cells)
df_singlets$frac <- df_singlets$number_of_cells/total_singlets
df_singlets$sample_id <- factor(df_singlets$sample_id)

df_singlets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_id, -number_of_cells), y = number_of_cells, fill = sample_id), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.8, size = 3)  + 
  scale_y_continuous() +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype='dotted', col = 'red') + 
  #annotate("text", x = "PBMC_spike", y = 0.052, label = "Expected PBMC fraction", vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust=1), legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("Number of cell singlets") +
  xlab("sample_id")
```

### bar plot showing cell fractions in the pool based on demuxafy assignment
```{r fig.height=3}
# sum <- sum(subpage_data$number_of_cells[!subpage_data$sample_id%in%c("doublet", "unassigned")])
# subpage_data$frac <- subpage_data$number_of_cells/sum
# subpage_data$sample_id <- factor(subpage_data$sample_id)

#subpage_data %>% 
#  filter(sample_id!="doublet" & sample_id!="unassigned") %>%
df_singlets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_id, -frac), y = frac, fill = sample_id), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.8, size = 3)  + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = 'dotted', col = 'red') + 
  # TODO: generalise the PBMC spike-in
  annotate("text", x = "PBMC", y = 0.052, label = "Expected spike-in fraction", vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), legend.title = element_text(size = 3), legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("Fraction of cells") +
  xlab("sample_id")
```

### Singlet calls combined for Souporcell, Demuxlet, Vireo and Freemuxlet + cell fractions
```{r fig.height=3}
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

result_Demuxlet = read.table(snakemake@input[['demuxlet']], header=T)
result_Souporcell = read.csv(snakemake@input[['souporcell']], sep = "\t", header = T)
result_Vireo = read.csv(snakemake@input[['vireo']]), sep = "\t", header = T)
result_Freemuxlet = read.csv(snakemake@input[['freemuxlet']], sep = "\t", header = T)


singlets_Demuxlet <- result_Demuxlet[which(result_Demuxlet$DROPLET.TYPE =="SNG"),"BARCODE"]
singlets_Souporcell <- result_Souporcell[which(result_Souporcell$status == "singlet"),"barcode"]
singlets_Vireo <- result_Vireo[which(result_Vireo$donor_id != "unassigned"),]
singlets_Vireo <- singlets_Vireo[which(singlets_Vireo$donor_id != "doublet"),"cell"]
singlets_Freemuxlet <- result_Freemuxlet[which(result_Freemuxlet$DROPLET.TYPE == "SNG"),"BARCODE"]

assigned_Demuxlet <- result_Demuxlet[which(result_Demuxlet$DROPLET.TYPE =="SNG"),c("BARCODE","SNG.BEST.GUESS")]
assigned_Souporcell <- result_Souporcell[which(result_Souporcell$status == "singlet"),c("barcode", "assignment")]
assigned_Vireo <- result_Vireo[which(result_Vireo$donor_id != "unassigned"),]
assigned_Vireo <- assigned_Vireo[which(assigned_Vireo$donor_id != "doublet"),c("cell", "donor_id")]
assigned_Freemuxlet <- as.data.frame(result_Freemuxlet[which(result_Freemuxlet$DROPLET.TYPE == "SNG"),"BARCODE"])
colnames(assigned_Freemuxlet) <- "BARCODE"

# change calls in Demuxlet and Vireo from CEL file names to actual sample ID - matching souporcell names
# change %5_PBMC to PBMC_donor in all assignments
# not so easy, need to grab pool name for that, to make sure the sample IDs are correct 

meta <- df_samplesheet %>% filter(CAPTURE_ID == pool_name)
# TODO: edit CEL_sample to be GENOTYPE_SAMPLE_ID?
assigned_Demuxlet$assignment_SAMPLE_ID <- meta$SAMPLE_ID[match(assigned_Demuxlet$SNG.BEST.GUESS, meta$CEL_sample)]
assigned_Vireo$assignment_SAMPLE_ID <- meta$SAMPLE_ID[match(assigned_Vireo$donor_id, meta$CEL_sample)]

# TODO: generalise PBMC naming
assigned_Souporcell$assignment <- gsub("5%_PBMC_spike_ins", "PBMC_spike", assigned_Souporcell$assignment)

# check if everything makes sense
#unique(assigned_Demuxlet[c("assignment_SAMPLE_ID","SNG.BEST.GUESS")])

assigned_Freemuxlet$assignment_SAMPLE_ID <- NA

colnames(assigned_Souporcell) <- c("barcode", "assignment_SAMPLE_ID")
colnames(assigned_Demuxlet) <- c("barcode", "assignment", "assignment_SAMPLE_ID")
colnames(assigned_Vireo) <- c("barcode", "assignment", "assignment_SAMPLE_ID")
colnames(assigned_Freemuxlet) <- c("barcode", "assignment_SAMPLE_ID")

#x <- merge(x=assigned_Souporcell, y=assigned_Freemuxlet, by.x='barcode', by.y='BARCODE', all = TRUE)

df_list <- list(assigned_Souporcell, assigned_Demuxlet[,c(1,3)], assigned_Vireo[,c(1,3)], assigned_Freemuxlet)      
#merge all data frames together
demuxafy_assignment <- df_list %>% reduce(full_join, by='barcode')
colnames(demuxafy_assignment) <- c("barcode", "Souporcell", "Demuxlet", "Vireo", "Freemuxlet")

# add names to Freemuxlet column in order of priority - Vireo, Demuxlet, Souporcell
demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet <- ifelse(is.na(demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet), demuxafy_assignment$Vireo, demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet)
demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet <- ifelse(is.na(demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet), demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet, demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet)
demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet <- ifelse(is.na(demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet), demuxafy_assignment$Souporcell, demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet)

# shows unique assignment patterns between all tools
#unique(demuxafy_assignment[,2:5])

# make names consisent between souporcell calls and the other tools 
# the other tools used extension of SNP file names, therefore I am matching them and changing according to the souporcell names (except PBMC)
# this way I am making the names the same, but also covering for SNP <-> sample differences
# or maybe not- it actually doesnt know! 
# TO DO 
# for(sample in unique(demuxafy_assignment$Souporcell)){
#   if(!is.na(sample)){
#     
#     # the silliest way to do this I have ever seen, but it is working
#     sample <- gsub("_", "-",sample)
#     match <- grep(sample, demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet)
#     sample <- gsub("-", "_",sample)
#     demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet[match] <- sample
#     demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet <- gsub("-Tumour", "", demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet)
#     demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet <- gsub("-Blood", "", demuxafy_assignment$Freemuxlet)
# 
#     sample <- gsub("_", "-",sample)
#     match <- grep(sample, demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet)
#     sample <- gsub("-", "_",sample)
#     demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet[match] <- sample
#     demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet <- gsub("-Tumour", "", demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet)
#     demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet <- gsub("-Blood", "", demuxafy_assignment$Demuxlet)
#     
#     sample <- gsub("_", "-",sample)
#     match <- grep(sample, demuxafy_assignment$Vireo)
#     sample <- gsub("-", "_",sample)
#     demuxafy_assignment$Vireo[match] <- sample
#     demuxafy_assignment$Vireo <- gsub("-Tumour", "", demuxafy_assignment$Vireo)
#     demuxafy_assignment$Vireo <- gsub("-Blood", "", demuxafy_assignment$Vireo)
#     
#     demuxafy_assignment$Souporcell <- gsub("5%_PBMC_spike_ins", "PBMC-Donor-6", demuxafy_assignment$Souporcell)
#   }
# }

#for each name in columns other than souporcell find partial match between souporcell and other and rename the other 
#has to be done on each unique value in souporcell 
demuxafy_all_singlets <- nrow(demuxafy_assignment)

#write.csv(demuxafy_assignment, file=paste0(dir_save, "/", pool_name, "/AtLeastHalfSinglet_all_tools_all_singlets.tsv"))
#copy <- demuxafy_assignment
#copy$pool <- pool_name
#write.csv(copy, file=paste0(dir_save, "all_tools_all_singlets_merged.tsv"), append = TRUE)

demuxafy_assignment <- demuxafy_assignment[rowSums(is.na(demuxafy_assignment[2:5])) != ncol(demuxafy_assignment[2:5]), ]
demuxafy_assigned_singlets <- nrow(demuxafy_assignment)


#write.csv(demuxafy_assignment, file=paste0(dir_save, "/", pool_name, "/AtLeastHalfSinglet_all_tools_all_assigned_singlets.tsv"))
#copy <- demuxafy_assignment
#copy$pool <- pool_name
#write.csv(copy, file=paste0(dir_save, "all_tools_all_assigned_singlets_merged.tsv"), append = TRUE)

# find final consensus call for each barcode
# ok with any call that is given to a barcode most frequently (including only once)
# excluding NA calls
# excluding Freemuxlet calls, because they are based on other tools calls
for(row in 1:nrow(demuxafy_assignment)){
  assignment <- demuxafy_assignment[row, 2:4]
  assignment <- assignment[!is.na(assignment)]
  sample <- sort(table(assignment),decreasing=TRUE)
  demuxafy_assignment$call_based_on_at_least_one_tool[row] <- names(sample)[1]
  if(sample[[1]]>1){
    demuxafy_assignment$call_based_on_at_least_two_tools[row] <- names(sample)[1]
  } else {
    demuxafy_assignment$call_based_on_at_least_two_tools[row] <- "unassigned"
  }
}

#write.csv(demuxafy_assignment, file=paste0(dir_save, "/", pool_name, "/AtLeastHalfSinglet_all_tools_all_assigned_singlets_with_call.tsv"))
#copy <- demuxafy_assignment
#copy$pool <- pool_name
#write.csv(copy, file=paste0(dir_save, "all_tools_all_assigned_singlets_with_call_merged.tsv"), append = TRUE)

tools = colnames(demuxafy_assignment)[2:5]
demuxafy_assignment[tools] = !is.na(demuxafy_assignment[tools]) == 1

#library(upsetjs)

#ComplexUpset::upset(demuxafy_assignment, tools)

ComplexUpset::upset(
     demuxafy_assignment,
     tools,
     annotations = list(
         'Assignment'=(
             ggplot(mapping=aes(fill=call_based_on_at_least_two_tools))
             + geom_bar(stat='count', position='fill')
             + scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format())
             + ylab('Assignment')
             + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust=1), legend.position = "none")
         )
     ),
     width_ratio=0.1, 
     min_size=3
)
```

### bar plot showing cell fractions in the pool based on demuxafy + souporcell assignment
```{r fig.height=3}
sum <- sum(data$number_of_cells)
data$frac <- data$number_of_cells/sum
data$sample_id <- factor(data$sample_id)
data$Pool <- pool_name

# TODO: generalise to remove dependency on having a PBMC_spike sample-ID/spike-in
data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_id, -number_of_cells), y = frac, fill=sample_id), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge", width=0.8, size=3)  + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust=1), legend.title = element_text(size=3), legend.position = "none") +
```
